full_source_report:
MRI of left knee in sagittal section (Proton density with fat saturation, T1WI, T2WI with fat saturation), axial section (T2WI with fat saturation) and coronal section (T2WI with fat saturation):

* Blurred contour of the patellar tendon with increased signal intensity on T2WI is noticed, in favor of tear of patellar tendon.

* Blurred contour of medial and lateral femoropatellar ligaments with increased signal intensity on T2WI is noticed, r/o tear of medial and lateral femoropatellar ligaments.

* Subcutaneous soft tissue infiltration at anterior aspect of right knee is noticed.

> The contour of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.

Impressions: 
1. In favor of tear of patellar tendon
2. R/O tear of medial and lateral femoropatellar ligaments

Suggest clinical correlation
